access.reason: LinkedIn's User Agreement §8.2 bans bots, crawlers and browser add-ons that scrape it, and its robots.txt disallows /jobs/view/ and /jobs-guest/.

notes: Tavi never browses LinkedIn. It reads a job page you opened yourself, for the chat, and you may save that one posting. Your LinkedIn job-alert emails are the other way in.
